Since 1970, Er-Con has brought technical judgment and field experience together to solve demanding erosion and bank-stabilization challenges.

Our origin story

Built around the problem.

Er-Con’s story is one of specialization. For more than 50 years, the company has focused on the complex point where moving water, unstable banks and critical infrastructure meet.

That focus shaped a practical, field-informed way of working: understand the site, design for its actual conditions and carry the solution through installation. It is an approach refined across more than 3,000 completed projects around the world.

Today, Er-Con continues to connect surveys, engineering, permitting and field execution, giving clients a clearer path from the first signs of erosion to a durable installed solution.
